name: Cernach

attributes.attribute: borne by the Ulster hero Conall

text: Cernach is a cognomen, an epithet rather than a separate name. It marks Conall Cernach, the great hero of the Ulster cycle. Irish tradition applies the title to this champion alone.

okr.objective: Cernach is an epithet of the Ulster hero Conall Cernach.
key_results: It works as a cognomen, not a standalone name.
Irish tradition pins it on Conall Cernach alone.
okr.evidence: MacKillop, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
